lines.speaker: mattie_tolliver
lines.text: It's a good price and I've got two children. You'd take it. Don't stand there and tell me you wouldn't take it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Tollivers are paid, properly and legally, and they are fine. The corner burns in the spring regardless, because the claim was always the point.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Nobody did anything wrong. That's the bit that gets me. Every single person in that transaction behaved reasonably.
